explication: PowerShell is a cross-platform automation shell, scripting language, and cmdlet framework. Its principal runtime path accepts commands through a local pipeline, executes pipeline commands, and returns results; the excerpts show pipeline execution and local orchestration, but do not expose the complete parse-to-command wiring. The tree also shows separate management, CIM, utility, diagnostics, formatting, and remoting capabilities. Remoting’s client invocation and server-side output dispatch are visible in sampled source; other subsystem relationships are kept conservative because their implementation was not sampled.
